title: app crashes when parsing yt video link
body: opened everforge put youtube link in the input box and clicked process. screen went completely white. tried restarting app same thing happened again. literally unusable right now please fix asap i need to save this workflow video

title: "Extract Workflows" button not responding
body:
Hi team,

I pasted a reddit thread url into EverForge and hit parse. The summary loaded fine, but when I click the "Extract Workflows" button at the bottom right, nothing happens at all. There's no loading spinner or error popup.

I tried refreshing the browser tab, clearing my cache, and trying a different Reddit post, but clicking that button still does nothing. Am I doing something wrong or is the button disabled? Thanks!
